datasets.name: a9311838
datasets.displayName: Traffic Flow Contributions by Route Segments Summary
queryLines:
SELECT concat(OrdenTramoOrigen, '. ', TramoOrigen)   AS Origen,
       concat(OrdenTramoDestino, '. ', TramoDestino) AS Destino,
       sum(Aportantes) AS Aportantes,
       sum(Aportantes) / sum(sum(Aportantes)) OVER (PARTITION BY OrdenTramoOrigen) AS PctFila
FROM recaudo_dev.gold.agg_transicion_tramos
WHERE PeriodoOrigen BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-11'
GROUP BY OrdenTramoOrigen, TramoOrigen, OrdenTramoDestino, TramoDestino

datasets.name: d8411e27
datasets.displayName: Performance Rates by Score Version and Decile Analysis
queryLines:
SELECT ScoreVersion,
       Decil,
       sum(Incumplen) / sum(Aportantes) AS TasaReal
FROM recaudo_dev.gold.agg_desempeno_score
WHERE Periodo BETWEEN '2025-06' AND '2025-09'   -- periodo de prueba
GROUP BY ScoreVersion, Decil

datasets.name: bea91c40
datasets.displayName: Top Fifty Contributors Risk Scores and Economic Sectors
queryLines:
SELECT d.AportanteID,
       d.RazonSocial,
       d.ActividadEconomica             AS Sector,
       d.Regional,
       s.ProbabilidadIncumplimiento     AS Probabilidad,
       s.NivelRiesgo,
       array_join(s.Razones, ' · ')     AS Razones
FROM recaudo_dev.ml.score_riesgo s
JOIN recaudo_dev.ml.features_aportante_mes f
  ON f.AportanteID = s.AportanteID AND f.Periodo = s.Periodo
JOIN recaudo_dev.gold.dim_aportante d
  ON d.AportanteID = s.AportanteID AND d.EsActual
WHERE s.Periodo = (SELECT max(Periodo) FROM recaudo_dev.ml.score_riesgo)
  AND f.DiasMora = 0
ORDER BY s.ProbabilidadIncumplimiento DESC
LIMIT 50
